title: A crash never leaves a flow cycle's vendor running
description: A clean fwd stop already kills a running flow cycle's vendor (FW-C-038), but a crash or a kill -9 leaves it running with nothing watching it, still spending the Owner's plan until its wall clock ends, and the cycle never gets a report. Cycles are not ledger runs, so the startup reconciler does not know them. When a cycle's vendor starts, fwd records its process group in the cycle folder ($FW_HOME/flows/<key>/cycles/<fire>/vendor.json with pgid and started_at) and removes that record once the cycle's report is written. On start, before the scheduler runs, fwd finds every cycle folder that still holds a vendor.json, kills that process group the same way the reconciler kills a crashed run's group (killOrphanGroup: only when a live member's working directory is inside that cycle folder, so a reused group id is never signalled), writes the cycle's run report with outcome failed and a reason that starts "orphaned", and removes the record, so a second start writes nothing more.
acceptance: A cycle running when fwd is killed leaves its vendor behind (the premise)
When fwd starts again on the same home, every process of that cycle's vendor, grandchildren included, is gone within 15 seconds
The interrupted fire gets exactly one run report, outcome failed, reason starting "orphaned"; a second restart adds none
